binding: EffectIntentV1.stage=generation; ordinal=actual next PendingAgentStep ordinal. Exactly six prior Pins in this order, byte/type/source/caller checked against retained original backend/step/input/transcript objects and original LocalArtifactSelection. H resolves per-position exact actual earlier capture or independently admitted source descriptor from its original owner; selected template/renderer/ABI descriptors are not mislabeled new canonical captures; W uses actual source-owned handles. Equal records do not manufacture a pending step.

bound_inputs.input: actual fixed input ABI size and full transcript roster under existing maximum_request_bytes/metadata/member/depth limits
bound_inputs.prompt: PromptText scalar maximum1048576 plus actualUTF8 <= selected maximum_request_bytes and original pending retained bound
bound_inputs.refusal: No finite source bound, no corresponding enforcing source, unknown cost predicate, overflow or infeasible full programme => explicit unavailable before renderer. This design supplies dispatch/ownership semantics, not missing source qualification or fabricated CPU formula.
bound_inputs.renderer: exact earlier selected source Pin and qualified implementation, never user function

caller: fixed backend_agent_entry.prepare_completion_request_v3 -> actual source-selected renderer -> same WorkerGenerationRequestOwnerV2
failure: Failed/unknown renderer retains exact raw first error and observed prefixes. No invented rendered observation/request, no later HTTP, no ordinal reuse/retry. Later diagnostic/publication failures remain secondaries; return observation cannot certify unavailable dimensions. Actual rendered prompt, hash and UTF8 remain unchanged; no numerical/scientific method runs.

field_inverse.CompletionRequest: same completed rendered capture, admission, immutable sampling and prompt; all inherited source joins retained
field_inverse.observed_ns/cost_prefix: actual original render occurrence after return before publication; never self-publication cost

prior_captures_order: exact selected captured input ABI product
producer_order: register actual generation owner before work
derive source-specific entire render resource bound and reserve later two publications separately
H reserve all seven dimensions under original ledger and capture grant
invoke selected renderer exactly once in same original effect attempt
retain actual returned prompt or original failure/unknown prefix
send complete actual EffectObservation and authenticate acknowledgement
only complete known required renderer dimensions permit RenderedTemplateObservation publication
only completed rendered capture permits CompletionRequest publication
only completed semantic capture permits later HTTP grant

resources.admission: For every dimension d, actual_used[d]+unresolved_reservations[d]+this_bound[d]+retained_cleanup_and_control[d] <= original_cap[d]. Keep conservation and actual observations separate. A partial/unknown result retains its full outstanding reservation; no speculative refund. Complete source plan must fit all mandatory generations, not only the present success branch.
resources.cpu_ns: Finite selected source/enforcement B_cpu <= remaining original CPU allocation after outstanding/cleanup/control reservations. Reservation is not observed CPU. Original H observes physical aggregate CPU independently; absent known required observations cannot become measured zero.
resources.process_starts: Zero for original in-process renderer. No hidden server/model/process launch is part of render_template.
resources.read_bytes: Exact actual bytes read by selected renderer route, including every source/template/input/transcript read occurrence. Earlier body captures do not authorize a free reread. Minimum logical input extent is derived from those exact captured Pins; source-qualified bounded extra reads must be in original selected dependencies, otherwise refuse.
resources.retained_bytes: Finite B_retained from same actual source-specific routine including input/transcript/template, prompt return, parser/encoder/hash copies and maximum live intermediates. Include existing source pending-retained limit, original retained share and future-publication reserve; no guessed one-buffer formula.
resources.wall_ns: Finite B_wall <= remaining original G deadline and original wall allocation, including blocked calls/validation. Original monotonic mapping and S/R/G/J/E do not reset. The fixed source enforcer must stop/refuse at original bound; no full-lifecycle new timeout.
resources.work_units: Finite B_work evaluated by the fixed source-specific bound compiler over exact renderer implementation/ABI, full input/transcript/template lengths, and unchanged prompt/output limits. A character-size heuristic for arbitrary code is not a proof. Missing compiler/proof/enforcement refuses before grant.
resources.write_bytes: Pure template rendering has zero external writes; any original selected route requiring a physical write needs its source-specific already selected bound and fixed sink before this site is feasible. No arbitrary writable callback/sink is introduced. Later two H publications are separate complete reservations.

scope: one existing fresh original PendingAgentStep; no new generation/replicate or sampler change
